---
title: "Categorical features"
---

Steps that manage a categorical column's levels and turn them into numbers
(the grouping follows [Feature Engineering A–Z](https://feaz-book.com/)). In
the [eight-position ordering](../basics/four-stages-eight-steps.qmd) these fill
[Missing: category levels](../four-stages/missing-category-levels.qmd) and
[Wrangle: dummy variables](../four-stages/wrangle-dummy-variables.qmd).

Three steps to know:

- `StepDummy`: expand levels into drop-one indicator columns (`StepOneHot`
  keeps all levels).
- `StepUnknown`: give missing categorical values their own level before
  encoding.
- `StepOther`: collapse infrequent levels into a single ``"other"`` level;
  merged on main ([#236](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/pull/236)) and
  not yet in this build.
